T-001.Title: Authorable Clarification child shape, teaching diagnostics, and matching exact guides

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-HEAD-RED (authorable half): before any grammar.ts production edit, in its own tool round trip, write tests in src/artifact/grammar.test.ts that plant a Clarifications section with one Clarification per family (exactly one self-closing IC-* child, one INV-* child, and one AC-* child on three separate Clarification elements) on a change spec AND on a change plan, and assert validateNgraceProject emits none of artifact.semantic-anchor-attribute, change.invalid-clarification, and change.invalid-clarification-target. Also plant zero target children, two or more target children, a non-IC/INV/AC child, and a leftover target attribute (with and without a valid child) and assert each errors. resolved="true" and status="resolved" remain legal. HEAD today: the attribute form of each family emits artifact.semantic-anchor-attribute; a Clarification with only a child and no target attribute emits change.invalid-clarification ("requires a non-empty target attribute"); grammar.test.ts is green on a one-code negative ("validates Clarification targets on change specs") while the fixture is dirty. The new document-clean asserts fail. Record cursor fail. Do not land the shape in this round trip. Never a red backed only by a grep; never fail and pass in one tool call; never a retrospective red via stash. Failure conditions: only IC sampled; document-clean claimed because one code is absent; this round trip also lands production; attribute exemption; target accepted as text content.

AC-HEAD-RED (diagnostic half): before any grammar.ts production edit, in its own tool round trip, write tests that plant the three HEAD triggers (non-Clarification child of Clarifications; Clarification with no target; target that is not a canonical IC/INV/AC id) and assert each emitted message names the working form (exactly one self-closing IC-*/INV-*/AC-* child) as the first shape and does not instruct a target attribute. A single shared message serving both change.invalid-clarification sites satisfies; do not count strings. Bind a closed expected-shape list in the test; assert literal bytes there. HEAD today: one change.invalid-clarification instructs a target attribute holding an IC-*/INV-*/AC-* token as the repair; the other requires a non-empty target attribute; change.invalid-clarification-target requires the target value to be a canonical IC-*, INV-*, or AC-* anchor. None names the child form. The asserts fail. Record fail. Do not land production in this round trip. Failure conditions: only one of the three sites asserted; working form named after an attribute instruction treated as enough; lint explain cited as the bind; this criterion treated as a quoted-byte bind in the plan; this round trip also lands production.

AC-HEAD-RED (exact-guide half): before any catalog.ts production edit, in its own tool round trip, write tests in src/lint/catalog.test.ts that the exact guides for change.invalid-clarification and change.invalid-clarification-target each name the working form (exactly one self-closing IC-*/INV-*/AC-* child) as the first shape and do not instruct a target attribute. Bind a closed expected-shape list in the test; assert literal bytes there. The change.duplicate-clarifications-section guide is not a member and is not asserted. Do not rewrite PREFIX_COVERED_LEGACY_CODES, the resolution-path tests, or the AC-FIX-SHAPE describe. HEAD today (measured at 7e8b7de): both members classify as exact; the first explanation admits only Clarification children that carry a non-empty target attribute (1 rendered line mentions target); the second explanation requires the target value to be a canonical IC-*/INV-*/AC-* anchor and its remediation says to point target at a real contract (4 rendered lines mention target, including the code token and title). Neither names the child form first. The asserts fail. Record fail. Do not land production in this round trip. Failure conditions: only one of the two guides asserted; working form named after an attribute instruction treated as enough; emitted message cited as a substitute; this criterion treated as a quoted-byte bind; this round trip also lands production; the code or title renamed to move a word-count.

Production (same edit, own tool round trip after the three reds): Clarification with exactly one self-closing IC-*/INV-*/AC-* child lints clean per family on a spec and a plan. Cardinality is closed. The F23 test name "validates Clarification targets on change specs" is gone; its replacement asserts the document is clean, not that one code is absent. Every diagnostic on this element's shape leads with the working form and does not instruct a target attribute. The two change.invalid-clarification sites may share one string. The duplicate-Clarifications-section diagnostic is not a member and is not rewritten to name the child. In the same tool round trip, rewrite only the exact guides for change.invalid-clarification and change.invalid-clarification-target so each names the working form as the first shape and does not instruct a target attribute. Do not restructure the catalog, touch the resolution-path predicate, or rewrite any other exact guide. Failure conditions: only IC sampled; one-code negative kept as the clean proof; attribute exemption; dual-read; only one diagnostic site rewritten; only one exact guide rewritten; emitted message used as a substitute for the guide, or the reverse; catalog files other than those two entries and their test edited.

AC-ATTRIBUTE-FORM-REJECTED (F45 exempt from AC-HEAD-RED): a Clarification that still declares a target attribute whose value is a canonical IC-*, INV-*, or AC-* anchor remains an error after the child form lands. A document that has both the attribute and a valid child is still an error. This half is already true at HEAD via artifact.semantic-anchor-attribute. Write the assert; it passes the moment it is written. Do not record it as a fail. Do not make the attribute form lint-clean. Failure conditions: attribute form accepted as an alias; exemption; this green-at-HEAD negative recorded as the HEAD-RED for P1.12.

Each test calls validateNgraceProject on the planted document and asserts it is clean of the three Clarification-shape codes, then calls evaluateApproveGate. HEAD today (post T-001): the fixture is lint-clean and approve PERMITS because listClarifications reads attributes.target and skips empty. The refuse / present=false asserts fail. Record fail for both families. Existing attribute-form refuse tests must not carry this red (F28). Do not record this red at repo HEAD (the lint-clean half is then unreachable). Never a red backed only by a grep; never fail and pass in one tool call. Failure conditions: red recorded before T-001; only IC planted; refuse asserted without validateNgraceProject on that document; attribute-form green cited as this red; this round trip also lands the reader.

AC-HEAD-RED (apply half): after T-001, before the reader edit, in its own tool round trip, write the D2 apply fixture (AC-SAMPLE child, plan Satisfies AC-SAMPLE, recordReviewVerdict so no-verdict does not hide the issue). validateNgraceProject is clean, then evaluateApplyGate. HEAD today (post T-001): the fixture is lint-clean and apply does not emit gate.apply.clarification-unresolved (same attributes.target skip). Record fail. Failure conditions: approve-only evidence cited as apply; Satisfies omitted; attribute-form plant; other apply requirements left failing so this issue is invisible; this round trip also lands the reader.

On the lint-clean IC and INV fixtures, unresolved refuses approve with gate.approve.clarification-unresolved and no-unresolved-ic-inv-clarification present=false; resolved="true" permits and that requirement is present=true. Rewrite the existing attribute-form plants so core.test.ts no longer contains Clarification target=. Failure conditions: dual-read; only IC; refuse without a lint-clean document; AC treated as an approve blocker; old attribute-form test kept as the only evidence.
